cr_data.provenance: Estate of the artist, 1986; The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation, Abiquiu, New Mexico, 1993; Gerald Peters Gallery, Santa Fe, New Mexico, 1994 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March, 1946. . . . No signature." Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks note of inscription 3 [do not mention "Good/Old"]. Abiquiú Notebooks notes inscriptions 1, 2 and indicates, "Note: From O'Keeffe. 'Final painting of the zinnias.'" Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 13. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: In this semiabstract landscape, large green trees stretch in front of a deep blue lake. Alongside these trees is a bright white birch tree with yellow leaves. Beyond the lake, purple mountains rise beneath a blue sky filled with rippling clouds.
title: Flower and Vase
